meta.name: Sitcom Legends: The Neighborhood
meta.description:
Big names, big laughs, and big hearts all have a home here on Pluto TV’s Sitcom Legends. Gather on the couch for some of the funniest friends and families on TV, any time of day or night.

Shows: The Neighborhood, The King of Queens, Rules of Engagement, The Conners
Available on: Pluto TV
